Jabberwookie's Counter Codex

Pick whoever keeps ruining your fun. You get their most popular builds and the items that get you out of sticky situations against them.

Gets you out Shut them down (use on them) Looks like a counter, won't work
The counter logic runs off an effect-tag engine, so it stays consistent from one hero to the next. Kits and item stats come from live Deadlock data via deadlock.wiki and the community API. The build numbers are a snapshot, so hit the full builds link on a hero to see what's actually meta today. Want to change something? All the HEROES and ITEMS data sits at the top of the script.
